description: 'Variation to condition 2 of planning permission ref: 2023/02863/FUL granted 15th December 2025 for the 'Alterations to the main dwellinghouse to include: creation of new window openings and raising of the dormer roof by 750mm, raising of the flank wall the roof level by 380mm, replacement of existing rooflight with an enlarged rooflight in the western elevation roofslope, replacement of 2no existing windows with new enlarged windows at second floor level to the eastern elevation, and alterations to the southern elevation to include the replacement of 1no window with new sliding doors at lower ground floor level, replacement of remaining doors and windows with new enlarged doors and windows, and replacement of existing Juliet balcony railings with new railings at upper ground floor level; alterations to the garage building to include: conversion of the first floor from one bedroom annex ancillary accommodation to the main dwellinghouse into a self-contained studio flat, erection of a single storey extension to the side of the building, erection of new external staircase and re-location of the existing air source heat pump underneath the staircase, formation of a roof terrace at first floor level to the southern elevation of the garage building, and replacement of the existing garage 3no garage doors with 2no new garage doors to the eastern elevation'.
